verdict.rationale: No first-party evidence in the pack documents Zap conditional branching, filters, parallel paths, or merging of branches. The only related community remark is a vague comparison noting that Zapier allows 'more simultaneous IFs & THENs' than IFTTT. Other community posts complain about missing conditional logic, so the capability is unevidenced rather than disputed.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can branch a workflow with conditions, filters, and parallel paths that merge back together
